new_migration.change: create or replace of public.authorize_consumer_artifact_download(uuid,uuid,text) with an identical body except the render_job_id lookup on consumer_packet_artifact_provenance. Previously: WHERE p.briefcase_item_id = v_grant.briefcase_item_id only (no owner filter, no LIMIT — safe today solely because briefcase_item_id is the table PK). Now: the lookup additionally requires p.consumer_auth_user_id, p.matter_id, p.revision and p.verification_hash to equal the grant's owner, matter, artifact_revision and verification_hash, and carries ORDER BY p.revision DESC, p.render_job_id DESC LIMIT 1 with a comment stating why: future per-revision provenance rows must not turn the lookup into an arbitrary pick. The function's execute ACL (revoke public/anon/authenticated, grant service_role) is restated so the migration stands alone. No behavior change under the current single-row-per-item schema — the grant-selection join already pins p.revision = g.artifact_revision, so the added filters cannot lose the row.
new_migration.note: Authoring only. No migration was run anywhere; live migrations are Roger-gated.
